• Hidden or unavailable caller IDs are not supplied to this app. Use your Phone app’s private-number blocking setting if available.

• Couriers, doctors and other people with unsaved numbers will also be rejected. Pause blocking when you expect a call.

• Rejected calls may go to carrier voicemail. WhatsApp and other app calls are outside this app’s scope.

• Caller ID can be spoofed. A saved number is not proof of who is calling.
No internet access, ads, account or contact upload. Android checks whether a caller is saved. This app does not request access to your contacts or call log.
How to test on my phone

1. Select Contacts Only for call screening and enable blocking.

2. Call this phone from a saved contact: it should ring.

3. Call from a number not saved anywhere in Contacts: it should be rejected without ringing. Check the activity list.

4. Pause blocking, then repeat the unsaved call: it should ring.

5. Disable blocking and check that calls ring normally.

Then test with the screen locked and after restarting your phone and unlocking it once. If you use two SIMs or Wi-Fi calling, repeat for each.

The activity list records the app’s decision, not independent confirmation of what the network did. Do not call emergency services as a test.
